caption: Design B wins on both metrics: 90% completion against 80%, and 7.5% errors against 15%. Notice the denominators — completion counts 20 users, while error counts 40 attempts.

spec.title: Count ÷ total = rate
spec.aria: A table comparing two VR menu designs: design A has 16 of 20 users complete (80%) and 6 errors in 40 attempts (15%); design B has 18 of 20 complete (90%) and 3 errors in 40 attempts (7.5%).
